I read that as a hedge, which the rule scores at face value. It isn't a hypothetical in the rule's sense: he doesn't say "suppose" or "let's imagine", and he states a date he believes.

I read it as a claim that the system can be built within that window, and I don't think this makes the case borderline. "Indistinguishable" from a person's claim to be conscious may also be hard to test. That would affect its status when it's entered (possibly `unfalsifiable`), not whether it's admitted.
